name: NVIDIA Corp.
logic: The ultimate proxy for global AI hardware infrastructure spending, data center compute, and GPU market share dominance.

name: Microsoft Corp.
logic: Tracks enterprise software monetization and mainstream corporate adoption of Generative AI via Copilot and Azure.

name: Broadcom Inc.
logic: Tracks custom AI ASIC chips (like Google TPUs) and high-speed data center networking switch demand.

name: Alphabet Inc.
logic: Measures massive hyper-scaler capital investments into data factories and consumer-facing AI model deployment.

name: Amazon.com Inc.
logic: A direct indicator of institutional enterprise migration to cloud-hosted AI model platforms.

name: Meta Platforms Inc.
logic: Represents open-source AI infrastructure deployment (Llama) and AI-driven ad-targeting optimization.

name: ROBO Global AI ETF
logic: A diversified thematic basket tracking pure-play software, data infrastructure, and service layers of the AI economy.

name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
logic: The premier institutional benchmark used to gauge the macroeconomic momentum, liquidity, and trading velocity of the global chip sector.

name: iShares Semiconductor ETF
logic: Tracks a market-cap-weighted index of the 30 largest US-listed chip designers and fabricators.

name: SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF
logic: Equal-weighted index that highlights the financial health of small-to-mid-cap specialty chip design firms over tech giants.

name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
logic: The ultimate physical bottleneck of global technology. Fabricates over 90% of advanced processing chips for Apple, Nvidia, and AMD.

name: ASML Holding N.V.
logic: Holds an absolute global monopoly on Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines required to manufacture sub-3nm chips.

name: Applied Materials Inc.
logic: Leading indicator of global semiconductor fabrication plant (fab) construction and factory line expansion.

name: Lam Research Corp.
logic: Tracks specialized wafer fabrication equipment, indicating supply-chain resilience and manufacturing scale.

name: Intel Corp.
logic: Represents legacy x86 personal computer CPU volume and Western efforts to onshore sovereign semiconductor fabrication.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
evaluate_metric: Market Cap Ratio to INTC & NVDA
logic: The premier cross-over indicator tracking market share gains over Intel in data center CPUs and Nvidia in budget GPUs.

name: Arm Holdings plc
logic: Monitors the multi-year structural architectural shift away from legacy x86 processors toward power-efficient mobile and cloud architectures.

name: Qualcomm Inc.
logic: Acts as the primary demand proxy for global smartphone volume, mobile systems-on-chip (SoCs), and automotive computers.

name: Micron Technology
logic: The absolute best indicator for checking chip supply gluts or shortages. Memory is highly cyclical and reacts first to supply imbalances.

name: Apple Inc.
logic: Tracks the closed-ecosystem deployment of advanced proprietary M-series and A-series silicon, serving as a high-end consumer hardware proxy.

name: CBOE Volatility Index
logic: Wall Street's 'Fear Gauge.' Sudden spikes signal geopolitical panic, institutional hedging, or immediate structural market turmoil.

name: Crude Oil Futures (WTI)
logic: Reacts instantly to geopolitical friction, active wars, or physical trade blockages in strategic areas like the Middle East.

name: Global X Robotics & AI ETF
logic: Tracks global robotics and automation adoption cycles, behaving more like a macro-sensitive industrial indicator than a semiconductor benchmark.

name: iShares Aerospace & Defense ETF
logic: Tracks major defense prime contractors. Rises when international political tensions forecast scaling defense budgets.

name: Breakwave Dry Bulk Shipping ETF
logic: Tracks dry bulk shipping costs. Drastic drops or surges expose structural supply chain friction, global trade slowdowns, or retaliatory tariffs.

name: iShares China Large-Cap ETF
logic: Serves as an indirect counter-proxy for international trade wars. Drops drastically when aggressive tariff policies target global exporters.

name: SPDR Gold Shares
evaluate_metric: Spot Price relative to US Dollar
logic: The premier safe-haven index. Evaluates central bank asset diversification away from fiat currencies and signals systemic inflation hedging.

name: VanEck Gold Miners ETF
logic: Tracks physical gold extraction companies. Evaluates operational profitability shifts resulting from major geographic gold findings or asset reassessments.

name: Bitcoin / Digital Assets
logic: Evaluated as a decentralized digital store of value that gains momentum during regional banking panics or macro capital controls.

name: US Dollar Index (DXY)
logic: Measures 'King Dollar.' A strengthening DXY signals global capital moving to safety, which strips liquidity out of international and emerging markets.

name: CBOE 10-Year Treasury Yield
logic: Represent the global risk-free rate. Rapid drops reveal institutional 'flights to safety' via bonds, while surges signal structural inflation worries.
